items.title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
items.summary: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.
